Name: Scythe Area Extended
Author: KringleKiller
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Allows adjsutable cut area for the scythe with config via GMCM

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Install via Vortex or unzip folder into Stardew Valley\Content\Mods

[b]Main features[/b]
Adds configurable cut area to the scythe. Desiged with other mods in mind, should be compatible with most other mods that affect the behavior of the scythe, including harvest with scythe mods, and supports all associated XP gains. 

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI

Downloads.Description: Small update to add configurable hotkey. Must have tool selected. The hotkey cycles through extensions options available in gmcm.
